title: Initial Evaluation (Behavioral Health)
about: The initial evaluation that follows a new person's preliminary triage, with the twelve elements SAMHSA's CCBHC criteria require (4.d.3), and the time frames of 2.b.1: within one business day for an urgent need, ten business days for a routine one. The clinician records their own preliminary diagnoses, coded in ICD-10-CM; the form suggests none. A comprehensive evaluation follows within 60 calendar days of the first request.

source.name: SAMHSA CCBHC Certification Criteria (2023, updated August 2025): 2.b.1 and 4.d.3
